factors.title: Post-holiday sales drop
factors.text: The week ending 2012-01-06 fell right after the holiday season, and the baseline used for comparison included Christmas week, which was the peak week at $3.22M. Sales naturally dropped after the holidays, and the chain median drop was −25.3%, very close to this store's −26.7% drop.

factors.title: Holiday-season department shortfalls
factors.text: All of the shortfall came from departments that peak in November and December, such as Toys, Electronics, and Media & Gaming. These departments normally drive holiday sales but returned to normal levels after the season ended.

factors.title: Comparable store performance
factors.text: This store ranked 20th out of 45 stores, meaning its drop was close to the chain average. The drop was only 1.4 percentage points more than the median store, indicating a broad post-holiday trend rather than a store-specific issue.

report.ruled_out: The drop was not caused by unusually warm weather, since temperatures were nearly the same as last year (47°F vs. 45°F), and fuel prices had only a modest impact.
report.bottom_line: The sales shortfall was part of a normal post-holiday decline shared across the chain, driven by the end of the holiday shopping season and the inclusion of Christmas week in the baseline. This store performed similarly to the chain median, so no store-specific issue is evident.
